summary: Overnight pass. Both Lloyds container houses closed yesterday afternoon and Lloyds hides the result, so they are off the list; the last bids seen were $6,400 at Shepparton and $4,000 at Dubbo. Two unused units of the same brief are now up at Lloyds Austral NSW closing 7 Oct, bid $5,700 and $7,900, but Austral is 590km so a tilt-tray has to be priced in. The $800 Husqvarna 390 XP is pending; a serviced MS 661C with a 25in bar at $1,500 in Melbourne takes its place. Tractor and ripper: nothing new in range. Everything else is unchanged.
headlines: Both Lloyds container houses closed yesterday; Lloyds hides the result. Last seen $6,400 Shepparton, $4,000 Dubbo.
Two more unused 2-room, kitchen, bathroom expandables at Lloyds Austral NSW, bids $5,700 and $7,900, close 7 Oct; 590km, price a tilt-tray.
Chainsaw: the $800 Husqvarna 390 XP is pending. New: Stihl MS 661C, serviced, 25in bar, $1,500, Melbourne.
Portable home: Cobram base-unit expanding cabin, 2 bedrooms and bathroom, no kitchen, $19,990, 210km.
Offsets: Armstrong WCH 24-plate with recent service, $7,250, Nagambie, 290km; replaces the worn-plate Baldan.
Mac mini: first private listing, sealed M5 Pro 64GB/1TB, $4,849, Sydney pickup, $100 under Apple. Tractor and ripper: nothing new.
